glebis-claude-cognitive-toolkit-root.description: Guided CBT and DBT practice exercises — thought record, opposite action, TIPP, DEAR MAN (with roleplay), wise mind, chain analysis and behavioral activation — with configurable Socratic pushback and optional health context. Triggers on "/cbt", "/dbt", "/thought-record", "/record", "/opposite", "/opposite-action", "/tipp", "/dear-man", "/wise-mind", "/chain", "/activate", "I need to work through something", "help me with a thought", "cognitive distortion", "I'm spiraling", "can we do a thought record", "I need to calm down", "help me ask for something", "how do I say no", "I can't decide",…
